resources.name: UniMorph
resources.coverageClaim: The current catalog advertises 169 annotated languages; Indonesian is listed with 27,714 forms and 3,877 paradigms. The listed Greek resource is Ancient Greek (grc), not a direct Modern Greek guarantee.
resources.licenseDecision: not bundled; per-language source/license audit required before acquisition
resources.protocolRole: surface -> attested lemma/POS candidate evidence only

architecture: morphology analyzer candidates -> exact OMW/OdeNet lemma/POS lookup -> unique external identity or fail closed
safetyRules: no stemming, edit distance, nearest lemma, or frequency sense selection
multiple surviving external IDs remain ambiguous
morphology alone never grants exact identity

realUniMorphProbe.sampleDesign: 20 non-lemma surface forms per language; retain only forms with a UniMorph-attested lemma and a unique exact OMW/CILI identity for that lemma
limitations: This is a coverage probe conditioned on a known exact gold lemma, not an independent morphology accuracy benchmark.
No German repository was found in this acquisition pass; OdeNet remains the German lexical source.
Critical-negative morphology stress and full-context disambiguation remain outstanding.

decision: KEEP_GENERIC_ADAPTER; do not add language-specific suffix rules or bundle a resource until each selected language snapshot and license are pinned
